linkedin.core_guidelines: Post content every 3 days on weekdays (Monday to Friday) and every 5 days on weekends. Utilize long-form content, relevant hashtags, and thought leadership pieces.
linkedin.anti_spam_and_bot_rules: Avoid using overly formal language or excessive punctuation. Refrain from posting repetitive content or using too many links.
linkedin.high_reach_tactics: Collaborate with Egyptian thought leaders and influencers to expand your network and credibility. Utilize relevant, high-quality content to attract Egyptian professionals and businesses.

facebook.core_guidelines: Post content every 2 days on weekdays and every 4 days on weekends. Post on Sundays for maximum engagement. Utilize visual content, ask questions, or request feedback.
facebook.anti_spam_and_bot_rules: Be cautious with Facebook's algorithmic changes by posting content that encourages engagement. Avoid using overly promotional language or posting repetitive content.
facebook.high_reach_tactics: Create targeted ads using Facebook's advertising platform to reach specific demographics and interests within Egypt. Leverage Facebook's algorithmic features, such as Events and Groups.

instagram.core_guidelines: Post high-quality visuals every 1-2 days on weekdays and every 3-4 days on weekends during peak hours (6 pm - 9 pm EET). Utilize relevant hashtags like #EgyptianFashion.
instagram.anti_spam_and_bot_rules: Avoid using overly promotional language or posting repetitive content. Leverage Instagram Stories to share behind-the-scenes content or sneak peeks.
instagram.high_reach_tactics: Utilize the 'Question Sticker' feature on Instagram Stories to encourage engagement and start conversations.

tiktok.core_guidelines: Post short-form, entertaining videos every 1-2 days on weekdays and every 3-4 days on weekends during peak hours (6 pm - 9 pm EET). Utilize relevant hashtags like #EgyptianDance.
tiktok.anti_spam_and_bot_rules: Be cautious with TikTok's algorithmic changes by posting content that encourages engagement. Avoid using overly promotional language or posting repetitive content.
tiktok.high_reach_tactics: Participate in popular challenges and hashtags, such as #EgyptianDanceChallenge, to increase visibility and reach a wider audience.
